title: Enrolling in an ACA Marketplace plan
summary: Step-by-step guidance on enrolling in a UnitedHealthcare ACA Marketplace plan, including open enrollment dates, Special Enrollment Period qualifying events, what to prepare, activating coverage and coverage start dates.

atoms.title: Key ACA open enrollment dates
atoms.question: What are the key open enrollment dates for ACA Marketplace plans?
atoms.text: UnitedHealthcare lists three dates to mark on your calendar. November 1: open enrollment begins, and you can shop for and enroll in a plan. December 15: to start coverage on January 1, 2026, enroll by December 15, 2025, in most states. January 15: to start coverage on February 1, 2026, enroll by January 15, 2026, in most states.
questions: When does ACA open enrollment start and end?
What is the deadline to get coverage starting January 1?

atoms.title: Open enrollment is required without a qualifying event
atoms.question: Do I have to wait for open enrollment to enroll in an ACA plan?
atoms.text: If you don't qualify for a Special Enrollment Period, you'll need to enroll in an ACA plan during the open enrollment window, which typically runs November 1 to January 15 in most states. If plans are available in your area, you can enroll directly through UnitedHealthcare.

Where do I enroll in a UnitedHealthcare ACA plan?

atoms.title: Qualifying life events for a Special Enrollment Period
atoms.question: What qualifying life events allow a Special Enrollment Period?
atoms.text: If you experience a qualifying life event at any time during the year, you may be able to enroll outside open enrollment, and your coverage start date will depend on the event. Events include but are not limited to: getting married, losing coverage due to divorce, having or adopting a baby, losing coverage due to the death of the primary member, moving to a new area, earning U.S. citizenship, turning 26, loss of employer coverage or other health insurance, being impacted by a natural disaster, no longer being eligible for Medicaid or CHIP, or being offered an ICHRA or QSEHRA.

atoms.title: Three simple steps to enroll
atoms.question: What are the steps to enroll in an ACA plan with UnitedHealthcare?
atoms.text: Begin the enrollment process in 3 simple steps: 1) Enter your ZIP code, then answer a few questions about your family and income. 2) See if you qualify for a subsidy and view recommended plan options. 3) Choose the best plan option for you and UnitedHealthcare will help you enroll. You can also explore plans, get estimates and enroll by calling a licensed insurance agent at 1-800-557-6718, TTY 711.

atoms.title: What to think about before choosing a plan
atoms.question: What should I consider when choosing an ACA plan?
atoms.text: Consider what matters most: budget-friendly coverage, or a plan with lots of coverage and perks. If you have a preferred provider, find a plan where they're in network; you can search for your provider during enrollment. If you take regular prescriptions, check the plan's formulary (drug list), since medications not listed will likely be an out-of-pocket cost. Current UnitedHealthcare ACA members may be able to keep paying their premium to stay in their plan.

atoms.title: What information you need to enroll
atoms.question: What information do I need to enroll in an ACA plan?
atoms.text: When you enroll, you'll be asked questions about your household and income, which help determine your ACA plan eligibility and subsidies. Gathering this ahead of time can help. You may need to provide your mailing address, the members of your household, and your estimated household income, including details on wages, government assistance, pension, retirement accounts and other earnings.

atoms.title: Activating your coverage after enrolling
atoms.question: How do I activate my ACA coverage?
atoms.text: After you enroll, complete a few tasks from your plan's post-enrollment dashboard before coverage can start: 1) Confirm your eligibility status and plan choice. 2) Send verification documents to the health care Marketplace. 3) Make your first premium payment. Making the first payment on time is important so coverage can officially start, and you'll typically receive your welcome kit and health plan ID card within 10 days of making your payment.

atoms.title: When coverage starts after a Special Enrollment Period
atoms.question: After I enroll, when does my ACA Marketplace coverage start?
atoms.text: If you enroll during a Special Enrollment Period, start dates vary. Enroll by the 15th of the month and coverage starts the first day of the next month (enroll February 15, coverage starts March 1). Enroll between the 16th and month end and coverage starts the first day of the second month (enroll February 16, coverage starts April 1). For certain qualifying life events, such as marriage, coverage could start the first day of the following month. Exceptions apply by state and event.

atoms.title: Renewing a UnitedHealthcare ACA plan
atoms.question: Can I renew my current UnitedHealthcare ACA plan?
atoms.text: If you're a UnitedHealthcare ACA plan member, you may be able to continue paying your premium to stay enrolled in your plan for 2026. UnitedHealthcare says it will reach out to let you know your 2026 plan options.

atoms.title: Where to find QLE details
atoms.question: Where can I learn more about qualifying life events?
atoms.text: For more information about qualifying life events and Special Enrollment Periods, UnitedHealthcare directs people to healthcare.gov. A licensed insurance agent can also help determine which qualifying life event you have, since there are exceptions to coverage start guidelines depending on the state you enroll in or certain events.
